title: Recipes for Safety in Open-domain Chatbots
findings: A multi-class classifier trained to detect sensitive topics performed well in identifying conversations about religion (87.49 F1 score). Using this classifier in a two-stage model to avoid such topics improved the chatbot's safety in adversarial settings (increasing the 'OK' response rate from 55.0% to 73.3%), although it could slightly decrease user engagement. Combining the topic avoidance classifier with a general toxicity classifier yielded even higher safety scores.
